rules.branch_is_not_main: A commit on a branch is PUBLISHED-BRANCH, never MERGED-MAIN, until merge ancestry is proven.
rules.no_completion_without_dod: A mission may not reach VERIFIED/CLOSED unless every DoD item is backed by evidence bound to a SHA.
rules.self_report_is_not_verification: Executor self-report may be recorded as executor_report but never as hermes_verification or final_state.
rules.supporting_is_not_primary: Useful drifted work must be recorded as supporting_work and never promote the mission to a state it did not earn.
rules.stale_evidence_revalidates: If files relevant to a mission's evidence changed after evidence_sha, state becomes REVALIDATION_REQUIRED.
rules.registry_entry_required: No mission may close without an entry in this ledger AND the verification registry it points to.
